description: One syndicate by id: its public page (name, pitch, operators, terms, members) under `syndicate` and its book (holdings, closed positions, balance curve) under `book`.

include.description:
Same `include` as a trader book: comma-separated section names,
omitted = all. Passed only on the book request.

limit.description:
Caps holdings and closed positions each, 1-200 (default all); above
200 is read as 200.

sort.description: Order of the book's holdings and closed positions (default newest).

name: get_syndicate
title: Get syndicate
